{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gadrin Dump''' was a landfill in the city of [[Gadrin]] on the planet of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. It was the base of the [[Borus's Boys]] gang following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].
